correctness.rationale: The six source families and every case n<=5 are exhaustively enumerated from complete n! lists, with the forbidden pattern independently tested on every triple. Full maximal-clique enumeration gives integer optima and counts of all labeled maximizers; an independent fixed-size clique recurrence confirms the counts and exclusion of one larger clique. Disjoint swap balls are independently checked against Kendall tau distance >=3 for every source pair. Exact nonnegative rational primal and dual certificate vectors for n=3..5 agree at the claimed fractional optima; trivial n=1,2 cases are proved. A standalone standard-library checker replays all these assertions.
